3.name: Psionic Power
3.notes:
You harbor a wellspring of psionic energy represented by your Psionic Energy Dice. The Psi Warrior Energy Dice table defines your die size and quantity at various Fighter levels.

You regain one expended Psionic Energy Die on a Short Rest and all expended dice on a Long Rest.

Protective Field. As a Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet takes damage, expend one Psionic Energy Die to reduce the damage by the die roll + your Intelligence modifier (minimum reduction of 1).

Psionic Strike. Once per turn, immediately after you deal damage to a target within 30 feet with a weapon attack, you can expend one Psionic Energy Die to deal extra Force damage equal to the die roll + your Intelligence modifier.

Telekinetic Movement. As a Magic action, move an object (Large or smaller) or a willing creature up to 30 feet. Tiny objects can be moved to or from your hand. Once used, it can't be used again until a Short or Long Rest unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die to restore it.

7.name: Telekinetic Adept
7.notes:
Your telekinetic abilities improve.

Psi-Powered Leap. As a Bonus Action, gain a Fly Speed equal to twice your Speed until end of turn. Once used, this cannot be used again until a Short or Long Rest unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die to restore it.

Telekinetic Thrust. When dealing damage with Psionic Strike, you may force the target to make a Strength save (DC = 8 + Intelligence modifier + Proficiency Bonus). On failure, choose to knock the target Prone or move it horizontally up to 10 feet.

10.name: Guarded Mind
10.notes:
You gain Resistance to Psychic damage.

If you start your turn Charmed or Frightened, you may expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) to end all effects imposing those conditions.

15.name: Bulwark of Force
15.notes:
As a Bonus Action, choose creatures (including yourself) within 30 feet, up to a number equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). Each chosen creature gains Half Cover for 1 minute or until you are Incapacitated.

Once used, the feature can't be used again until a Long Rest unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die to restore its use.

18.name: Telekinetic Master
18.notes:
You always have the Telekinesis spell prepared, and can cast it without a spell slot or material components. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

While maintaining Concentration on the spell, you can make one attack with a weapon as a Bonus Action.

Once used, this method of casting Telekinesis can't be used again until a Long Rest unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die to restore its use.
